review_description: Pricing was good against competitors for the same products. Communication was average (I understand the owners also do installations so I factored that into my review.Energy meter installed but not working after they left. Turned out the plug didn't quite fit due to an O-ring stopping it from connecting properly. Small thing but I would have thought it would be picked up on commissioning.

Alan & John were very prompt with their quote (within 24 hours), and work completed successfully and on time. It's clear they're very experienced in their work, and it was great to deal directly with both the owners (and the workers!) of the company.

Multiple problems with these guys, most of it due to them being busy I’m guessing  but after multiple failures by them to submit paperwork and applications we eventually gave up emailing them.  I hope their workmanship is better than their ability to reply to emails and click the send button. Much time wasted for no result. We will happily pay more elsewhere than waste any more time with them.
John and Alan are the real deal - no BS, no pressure, just an appropriate system for a fair price installed very professionally. Looking forward to seeing how it performs over the year.

most Solar suppliers wanted to sell me what they preferred and not what I wanted. Some even ignored my request for quotes on quality systems and just quoted on their preferred product even if it was 2nd or 3rd rate.

Alan and John  are great guys to deal with.  They did not ask for a deposit and straight forward details with no "bs".  I add a 3ph smart meter for a for a very good price before we did the install and all went well.   I will go back with them on our future upgrades or new system.

With Solar2020 all steps were so easy .. they were friendly and responsive .. the installation was quick and clean. They left some of the Meter change and final connection to the grid with me which was ok. Great company.
Polite, Loads of information and helpful advice given with patience! Quick and smooth install on the day, a great experience from start to finish. Highly recommended.

I enquired over email about a 5kw fronius inverter with 6.6kw of panel with Solar2020 and Alan got back to me that night with a quote for several options. This suited me as i didn't want to deal with a solar company salesman and from research i knew a rough cost.Synergy did their thing in 3 or 4 days, Alan and John arrived on time, were friendly, communicated everythin, did a great install and left no mess.It couldn't have gone any better or easier.
Easy and transparent to deal with. Punctual on install and great guys to boot. Everything done for us with no cut corners. Would highly recommend!

All dealings were by email but that suited me and all information was thorough, accurate and honest. No BS sales tactics or hassle, just a straight up honest quote for an LG / Fronius system.All steps were clearly laid out. On the day they were on time and did a very tidy, efficient job. I'm very happy with the outcome.Fabulous experience all round.

Finding an installer was easy there after, I contacted LG and they pointed me towards Solar2020 as they are an accredited LG installers which no doubt will count when it comes to possible warranty claims.In saying that whilst doing my research I got saveral other quotes for other systems as well as Fronius / LG. Fast and efficient install. Very good price and very quick to reply to emails. Took LG panels and a Fronius inverter. Very happy with Job. Neat and tidy in garage and roof looks great. Would highly reccomend this company.
Easy company to deal with - responded to questions, no payment required until install completed. Came back readily after install/payment stage to readjust a setting on the inverter

I found the information on your site very helpful. I went with solar edge inverter and LG panels- long warranties and high performance more important than initial cost. Very helpful guys at Solar 2020.
Alan and John  from Solar2020 were fantastic great price with the a great quality LG neon2 system and Fronius Inverter very clean and efficient in their workmanship very happy with our system.

From the three quote suggestions,one failed to respond (or did not leave a message)One pushed one product only although later offered alternatives when i resisted. Eventually stopped answering my emails.The final company was fine, generally responsive and paid two visits to my house to assist. However they generally pushed cheaper brands and i was not convinced of the value for money so i put the process on hold. Work was done mostly professionally. System is really good with LG panels and fronius Inverter but comminucation have to be improved. If you want a good system with not being ripped off these are the guys.

Solar 2020 were not at all pushy, very well priced and excellent system and service-One was very pushy and were trying the hard sales tactics and kept trying for us to sign a contract even when we said we needed to do more research!-Another made an appointment to visit us to quote on the job, so we made sure we were both home, we waited for over 1/2 hour before calling him as he was late, he then told us he never had the appointment. even though we had a text confirmation.-The final one felt a bit amataturish, they gave us a general quote but we didn't feel confident with them.
Alan was first class, he installed the panels and explained everything and system is working well. Would highly recommend for price, quality and service.

Very professional right from quote to installation. Plenty of info supplied beforehand. System performs as stated.Showed me right through the system and app after install. On time and great quality work. Would recommend.

Overall a top company every thing explained even had samples of the product, which no one else had, no sales pressure, really pleased with solar 2020.They are dearer than lots of other companies but it is an LG system.

I really was happy with both Allan and John. They were both honest and genuine with their approach. I spent a lot of time reading on whirlpool and on this site.I am very happy with the quality of workmanship and no BS attitude. They mainly supply only good quality panels and inverter. LG and Fronius.They were never pushy at all, itâ€™s like you tell them what you want and they come and do it and will provide suggestions if you are unsure about anything.They helped with the setup of the smart meter and everything was working perfect when they left. So far absolutely loving the system, only 1 glitch and that was with the smartmeter but that could have been our impatience. I rated the system as fantastic even though it is early days. The installation company were very helpful, gave advice and were very efficient with the installation. Very happy with their service.

Alan and John are great guys, good communication while installing, and perfect system, love it! We have the Fronius inverter with Smart Meter, which was an extra $500 but worth every dollar! So fun to see what you produce, what you use, which appliances you can run together without using the grid etc. Following their advice, we have installed 25 panels (Canadian), which delivers around the max of 5kWh almost every day now for many hours a day.
Would gladly recommend Alan and John to anybody who is looking for quality system and value for money.
Love the app on the phone ,personell were really friendly and helpful.

Intially went to Infinite Energy despite the 3 quotes recommended via solar quotes, as they had been recommended by someone who has used them.  However, they recommended Solar2020 as my roof space was limited and that I would best to use micro-inverters.  They were impressive in their customer service as were Solar2020 who ultimately installed my system
Solar 2020 have been really good from the quotes and understanding my requirements to an excellent installation.Would recommend them to anyone.

Well i can't rate Solar 2020 high enough they exceeded all of my expectations plus more, they don't pressure with sales pitches and the quality of there workmanship is second to none.The system is producing more than predicted even with low shading in the early morning so i'm all smiles.

Great experience with all of the companies you recommended but ultimately went with one that had a good reputation on Whirlpool forums that also provided me with best combination of price, quality, service and warranty peace of mind.

Advanced Solar Technology very pushy sales loaded with sales pitch for what was inferior products compared to the rest for much the same price as the rest. Also tried to push a strange set up, which in hindsight seems more likely an attempt to offload excess stock than benefit me.Infinite Energy very good, nearly did deal with them but in the end Solar 2020 just beat them by offering similar quality at a better price
